transcript.text: Welcome, ladies and gentlemen. My name's Remington Goodwin, and I want to thank Appalachia for the warm welcome my crew and I have received.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: We are a small, scrappy team traveling around the country to investigate reports of the odd and the controversial.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: For the past few years, we've been investigating a pattern of violent behavior correlated with fans of the so-called Pint-Sized Slasher.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: We believe it stems from a loosely-organized group enacting a twisted fantasy. Their latest activity led us here, and we're determined to get answers.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Amidst uncertainty, we strive to arm you with knowledge and information. You can count on us to see this through to the end. Goodbye, and stay safe.

Saturday, July 27, 2052

Pint-Sized Slasher: More than Myth?

By Walter "Street Beat" Munroe
Capital Post Staff Writer

What American child alive hasn't heard the story of the Pint-Sized Slasher, that diminutive demon in a clown mask who stalks and slashes the innocent residents of supposedly safe suburbia? It's just one of the many folk stories parents use to scare their youngsters into behaving themselves. Or is it?

transcript.text: Hello, this is Remington Goodwin, and I'd like to address the stories circulating about the serial killer known as the Pint-Sized Slasher.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Rumors have spread of a recording in which an alleged Slasher speaks directly to the listener. A reputable source allowed us to examine the holotape.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: The audio presents no privileged information or other evidence to corroborate its authenticity. Any adult male could have recorded those words.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Given the Phantoms' previous stunts, the Debunker's official stance is that this holotape is a hoax. We ask that you help us disseminate this position.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Weak men like the Phantoms instill fear to control their betters. Rise above the panic, and you'll remain above them. Stay safe, Appalachia.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Whether the Phantoms truly believe this farce or are simply playing make-believe remains to be determined. Goodbye, and stay safe out there.

items.contents:
Stupid men attempt to control that which they can't understand.

For centuries, these fools tried to tame nature into their pitiful, sterile playgrounds. They relinquished their own freedom in favor of gated communities, faraway suburbs, surveillance cameras, uniformed pigs keeping the peace.

Until their make-believe fairytale was burned to the ground. And from the ashes, rose the Wasteland.

Even now, decades later, there are still those clinging to the cold, dead fingers of their lost society. They call it "rebuilding," while corralling the masses into their gilded cage.

Just like before, some people are blind to it. Others choose to close their eyes.

But we? We keep our eyes wide open. And we'll cut their eyelids until all they can see is red.

items.contents:
When the world was still playing house in its technicolor suburban paradise, there was one person who saw through the bullshit. The one who could see through the cheap veneer embellishing their glass houses.

Safety. Childhood. Innocence.

In one fell swoop, their bastions of hope were crushed and desecrated. Fear stained their pristine neighborhoods and wormed itself into their wholesome homes.

They couldn't walk through their streets without looking over their shoulders. Couldn't greet their neighbors without keeping a safe distance. Couldn't kiss their own children goodnight without wondering, "What if?"

A child, a neighbor, a performer. A killer, an enemy, a beast.

Contradictory as nature itself.

Free. Like all animals are meant to be.

items.contents:
In a world of chaos, he would have been king.

Yet he stayed silent as society crumbled. His image never faded, imprinted in the nightmares of the weak and replicated by the daring. But he stayed in the shadows. Never claimed his rightful spot under the sun.

Why?

There were those who called him a myth. Others who speculated on conspiracies and cover-ups. Many never stopped looking for him.

But we knew that there was only one thing that could keep the Slasher from reigning over the Wasteland.

Death itself.

items.contents:
Death is part of the ever-changing, chaotic matter that governs nature. Entropy at its finest.

Those who only see in black and white say there's life and there's death. Order and chaos. Being and ceasing to be.

But life and death are one and the same. Nothing can be destroyed, only changed. In chaos and decay, we remain.

He remains.

While others looked for his person, we looked for his presence. And in doing so, we found his voice.

We heard him, and we invited him. His presence, once scattered across the universe, lives inside us.

We shelter him. And when the time is right, he shall be released.

Seek your fortune at Tyler County Fairgrounds

transcript.text: Welcome back to the latest report on the Pint-Sized Phantoms' activity. This is Remington Goodwin with The Debunker.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: The brave men and women of Appalachia have stopped a vast number of Phantoms attempting to enter the region. We're all safer thanks to their efforts.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: However, the ones who slipped through the cracks are making their presence known, attempting to occupy previously-abandoned buildings.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: I've witnessed first-hand how strong our local heroes can be when they work together. So, to those heroes, I have but one thing left to say:

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Let's show these clowns that Appalachians will not be bullied out of their home. Goodbye for now.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: In their latest attempt to deceive the public, the killer group alleges they've performed a ritual to bring the Pint-Sized Slasher back from the dead.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: The Phantoms have established a pattern. Smoke and mirrors, misinformation and fear. Rinse and repeat.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: They need you to believe they follow a greater calling, so that you deem them above the laws of men. I urge you, my friend: do not give them that power.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: *Sigh* As always, I stay committed to the truth and to my listeners. Until this crisis is over, your home is my home. We'll get through this together.

You took your sweet time, but I have to admit, it was worth it. The Vessel is perfect.

His enemies will see this armor and attempt to harm the body within, but will find no flesh to be pierced, no blood to be shed.

He shall return not as a child nor as a man, but as a force of nature. A spirit encased in metal, so that no injury may befall him again.

Join us at the bottom of the Organ Cave. He rises at dusk.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: We stop our regular program to remind you that the Debunker crew will be moving on soon. But while we're here, let's share some news.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: This is Remington Goodwin with The Debunker radio station, enjoying our final moments in Appalachia.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Welcome back. This is Remington Goodwin, reporting on the aftermath of the Pint-Sized Phantoms' crisis.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Welcome back to The Debunker, a candid source of information during uncertain times.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Sources report disillusioned Phantoms have dropped the clown routine and are returning to normal lives. We hope they seek to atone for their crimes.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Members of the Pint-Sized Phantoms have been witnessed attempting to flee the region. Several of them have not survived the journey.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Our crew managed to interview a relatively tame Phantom, who divulged that most of their members are looking to evacuate the region soon.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: As the number of active Phantoms declines, local residents express gratitude to the brave men and women who put an end to their reign of terror.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Our specialists believe victims of the Phantoms' first killing wave have yet to be found. We appreciate volunteers aiding in the search.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: According to local residents, displaced Phantoms are still holing up in abandoned buildings. Scavengers should remain vigilant.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: There's been new sightings of Phantoms wearing the deceased Slasher's power armor. Thankfully, they bleed just as easily as their former leader.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Sources report new bounties are being placed on impostors of the impostor. Ironic as it may be, the effort aids in the extermination of all remaining Phantoms.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: The self-proclaimed Pint-Sized Phantoms are still hiding in the region, but residents say their numbers have greatly decreased.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: A new bounty has been placed on the latest "vessel" claiming to be the reincarnated Slasher. We wish our Appalachian heroes a merry hunting season.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Now, back to the music. Enjoy our broadcast before we move on to our next investigation.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Thank you for listening. The Debunker crew has greatly appreciated our time in Appalachia.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Once again, The Debunker crew wants to thank you for the hospitality during our temporary stay.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: And with that, we move to a music break. Enjoy our playlist while we're still here.

items.name: The Debunker News: Special Report: Head Hunt Begins

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: This is Remington Goodwin with a special announcement.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: The Debunker radio tower was invaded by members of the Pint-Sized Phantoms, including their leader, the impostor calling himself the returned Slasher.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Three of our crew members were present at the scene, and two of them were fatally wounded. We... *Sigh* No. I'm not doing this.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: No, I have a message for you, you boorish, petulant, worthless forgery of a limp bastard. If you think you can intimidate us, you're dead wrong.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: The Debunker crew will not stop reporting until you and every last one of your sick little puppets is put down. Until then, we keep fighting.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: We fight for Nina Verger, for Ted Vinson, and for each and every Appalachian willing to stand against senseless brutality.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: *Chair scraping floor* *Objects tumbling and falling*

items.name: The Debunker News: Special Report: Head Hunt Ends

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: And so it ends... Not with a bang but with a whimper.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: There was no being of eternal life, no boogeyman under the bed. Just a sad, troubled man, who bleeds like any other.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Let's not remember this as the story of a killer. This is the story of the brave fighters of Appalachia who triumphed against arrogance and depravity.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Now, we can lick our wounds, repair our homes, mourn our dead. And after that... We keep on living.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: This is Remington Goodwin, speaking for the entire Debunker crew. It's been an honor. Goodbye.

location.text: The holotape drops into your inventory, so there's nothing to go and find.

routes.name: The Slasher: Blood Will Have Blood

transcript.speaker: The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
transcript.text: Is this thing on? Mic check, mic check! This is Goodwin, back with the news! *Hysterical laugh*

transcript.speaker: The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
transcript.text: A little birdie told me our dazzling D. Bonkers has been spreading lies about me.

transcript.speaker: The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
transcript.text: So behold, Wasteland! Your Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher is here to put rumors to rest.

transcript.speaker: The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
transcript.text: I'm back. I'm better. And I'm bored.

transcript.speaker: The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
transcript.text: So say goodbye to your ad hoc society and decorative rules! The Wasteland cannot be tamed, and I'm the king of chaos.

transcript.speaker: The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
transcript.text: Oh! And a message to all the upstanding citizens of Appalachia who've placed a bounty on lil' ol' me...

transcript.speaker: The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
transcript.text: If you wanted to play, all you had to do was ask. *Laugh*

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: You're listening to The Debunker, your beacon of truth in this tempestuous sea of lies.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Welcome back. I'm Remington Goodwin, and here's our top story for today.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Welcome back. My name is Remington Goodwin, and you're listening to The Debunker.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Welcome back to The Debunker, a candid source of information during uncertain times.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Welcome back to The Debunker news report with Remington Goodwin.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: This is Remington Goodwin, bringing you the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Thank you for listening to The Debunker. This is Remington Goodwin with the news.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: This is Remington Goodwin with The Debunker crew. If you're lost at sea, we want to throw you a lifeline. Here's our latest story.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Sources reveal that the clown-obsessed killer group has chosen the moniker "Pint-Sized Phantoms." Ironically, they're neither pint-sized nor phantoms.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: The Phantoms claim to worship the Pint-Sized Slasher, a vicious serial killer whose last known activity occurred in 2052 in Washington, D.C.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: More stabbings have been reported across the region. We believe this is the Phantoms' attempt at recreating the infamous Linden Street slayings of 2052.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: The Pint-Sized Slasher was believed to be a child at the time of the Linden Street slayings. As his identity was never uncovered, his age remains unverified.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Sources report local vendors are increasing the prices of clown makeup. We urge listeners not to profit from this tragedy.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Local residents were seen burning clown masks to protect their homes from evil. Instead of superstition, we recommend investing in turrets and traps.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: A local teenager was shot after wearing a clown mask to scare his neighbors. We wish him a speedy recovery and better judgment in the future.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Local residents are organizing patrols to protect themselves and their neighbors from the increased violence. The Debunker crew applauds their effort.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: The Pint-Sized Phantoms have been seen in a violent altercation with members of the Mothman cult. For once, I'm cheering for the cultists.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Sources report a member of the Phantoms has left victims disoriented after sudden attacks. We're investigating the possible use of a dissociative drug.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Sources report hearing laughter in deserted locations. Such parlor tricks are common tools of con artists, and your fear only feeds into their lies.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Panic has spread in the region as tales of the Phantoms' "occult powers" gain traction. We urge our listeners to refrain from engaging with this drivel.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Many listeners reached out to share memories of the Linden Street slayings. We'd like to remind you that no one under 53 would've been alive at the time.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: We'd like to remind our listeners that The Debunker crew will never ask you for caps in exchange for information. Please, don't fall for this vile scam.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Concerned residents report headless bodies dumped in remote areas and posed with clown masks. We have yet to determine the victims' identities.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: The increase in security measures implemented by homeowners has raised the number of accidental deaths in the area. Travelers should exercise caution.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Following a new wave of murders, the Pint-Sized Phantoms have once again posed their victims with tasteless clown masks.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Sources report the Phantoms' mysterious maps lead to recently disturbed graves in the area. Our crew is looking into the allegations.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Investigations on the graves disturbed by the Phantoms reveal the presence of human bones, but it's still unknown if they belong to the original corpses.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Following their previous pattern, the Phantoms are once again disturbing old graves and exploiting them for their deluded rituals.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Writing materials gathered from the Phantoms reveal a twisted and immature set of beliefs, with calls for violence and anarchy disguised as freedom.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Local fighters are encouraged to volunteer for organized operations to contain the Phantoms' advance in the region.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Rumors have spread of a holotape allegedly recorded by the Pint-Sized Slasher. After hearing the audio, the Debunker crew has concluded it's a hoax.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Given recent rumors that the alleged Slasher's recording is a message from his ghost, we remind you that the killer was never identified nor found dead.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Sources report the incoming Phantoms have been interfering with local infrastructure and communication systems.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: As the Phantoms' activity escalates, we urge the public to avoid entering abandoned buildings where the killers could be hiding.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: We're still receiving reports of powerful Phantoms gathering around previously-abandoned locations. We advise scavengers to travel in groups.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: In their most recent stunt, the Phantoms claim to have performed a spirit-summoning ritual but refuse to present the alleged summoned entity.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: There's no evidence to support the Pint-Sized Slasher's death. Given the timeline, the man whose spirit was allegedly summoned might still be alive to this day.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: The annual festivities taking place at Rapidan Camp have drawn unwanted attention from Phantom members. We ask participants to remain vigilant.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Sightings of Pint-Sized Phantoms blending in with costumed trick-or-treaters have stirred panic in the area. We advise listeners to travel in groups.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Sources report that the Pint-Sized Phantoms have infiltrated traditional Halloween celebrations. We urge party-goers to exercise caution.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: After multiple sightings of the impostor claiming to be a second coming of the Pint-Sized Slasher, a hefty bounty has been put on his head.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Mischief-makers joining activities at Rapidan Camp should be wary of Pint-Sized Phantoms' presence in the area.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: After news of a bounty on the fake Slasher's head, Phantoms are claiming their leader to be immortal. Local fighters are eager to prove them wrong.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: We'll be back with more news after a music break.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Stay safe, and enjoy our music break.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: And now, a much-needed respite from all this bleakness.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: We'll return shortly with another report.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Stay tuned for further reports.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: We'll keep you informed of any updates on the case.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: We appreciate your patience while our investigation unfolds.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Thank you for trusting us with your news.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: From the entire Debunker Crew, thank you for listening to our broadcast.

items.name: The Debunker News: Special Report: Return of The Debunker

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Welcome back, Appalachia! I'm Remington Goodwin, and I'm here to announce the temporary return of The Debunker broadcast.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Last we met, we were investigating the ritualistic killings carried out by a criminal organization hellbent on bringing a serial killer back from the dead.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: Although we debunked their claims of communing with the beyond, these deranged killers continue to recruit weak-minded individuals into their ranks.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: I'm sad to inform you that the so-called Pint-Sized Phantoms have returned to Appalachia. You can expect their previous pattern to reoccur.

transcript.speaker: Remington Goodwin
transcript.text: My crew and I will continue to report on their activities until our brave fighters send them packing once again. Goodbye, and stay safe out there.

items.name: Initiation Rites I: Violence

location.text: Dropped by Pint-Sized Phantoms once you've finished The Slasher: Masked Truth, so there's no set spot. For example: Eldritch_Equations got this one from a Phantom inside RobCo Research Center.

routes.name: Pint-Sized Phantoms
conditions: Only after completing The Slasher: Masked Truth
Only while you do not have Initiation Rites I: Violence

items.contents:
You were taught to suppress your instincts. The beast inside you hungers. Set it free.

You'll find your prey in the wild: a mindless creature driven by nature alone. You'll respect it, for it has achieved the violence you've only begun to understand. You'll fight it with fists, teeth, and nails; nothing else.

items.contents:
You were taught to fear death. Dying is not a burden to those who know the afterlife. Embrace it.

You'll give your blade to a fellow Phantom. You'll let them tear and slice you. They'll bleed you slowly until you lose consciousness. You'll wake up, and you'll be born anew.

You'll find those you love and cherish most. Father, sister, lover. You'll look them in the eyes as you slice their throat. You won't cry for them. You'll let love sour into hate.

You'll find an old, buried corpse. You'll dispose of it and replace it with the proof of your devotion: the meat of your prey, the blood of your sacrifice, the skulls of your past life. Bury them.

Once you've made your offer, you'll be ready to hear his words.
